metadata.description: Official Agent Skill for Dodo Payments: one dodo-payments skill covering checkout, subscriptions, webhooks, usage and credit billing, license keys, and more.

plugins.name: dodo-payments
plugins.description: Integrates Dodo Payments with the dodopayments SDK and the Dodo Payments MCP server. Covers checkout sessions, subscriptions and plan changes, webhook signature verification, usage-based (metered) billing, credits, license keys, products, discounts, localized pricing, customers and the customer portal, refunds and disputes, framework adapters, Better Auth, BillingSDK, mobile checkout, and test mode through go-live. Use whenever a task mentions Dodo Payments, dodopayments, a checkout or pay button, a subscription, a webhook from Dodo, metered or usage billing, credits, license keys, refunds, or a Merchant of Record integration, even if the skill is not named.
